summary: Frontend-only validation of the new « Tests de sécurité effectués » section on the public Sécurité page + PDF download + navigation regressions. All requested checks PASS: header-security-button and footer-security-link both open security-page; security-tests-section renders 5 cards (4 badges verts « Conforme », 1 badge ambre « Planifié » = Authentification MongoDB), each with Méthode and Résultat (5/5 each), the mention « vérifié le 19 août 2026 » and the italic Conclusion; section is positioned below the 9 security-pillar-* cards; security-pdf-download href = /dossier-securite-loi25.pdf which returns HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, 1 222 814 octets (~1.2 Mo) and contains 4 pages (verified via /Type /Page count); « Vos droits en tout temps » banner visible; security-privacy-link opens privacy-policy-page; security-back-button returns to the landing page. Landing regression OK (comparison section + footer) and admin login (admin@luminahr.ca) still works — dashboard « Bonjour, Dr. Sophie Lavoie » loads with all modules. No console errors observed.

issues: Cosmetic only: badge column width varies (Planifié badge narrower than Conforme), so card titles are not perfectly left-aligned across the 5 cards. Suggest a fixed min-width on the status badge.

critical_code_review_comments: SecurityPage.tsx: data-testid values are built from the raw French titles (e.g. security-test-Balayage externe des ports base de données (« test ultime »)) — spaces, accents and guillemets make selectors fragile. Prefer stable slugs/indexes (security-test-1..5, security-pillar-1..9). Same for security-pillar-*.
Section date « vérifié le 19 août 2026 » is hardcoded while the page footer still says « dernière mise à jour : juin 2026 » — inconsistent dates on the same page; consider updating the footer line.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public Sécurité page has no direct route — reach it via header-security-button or footer-security-link on the landing page (View state routing). Privacy page testid is privacy-policy-page (not privacy-page). PDF served from /app/frontend/public/dossier-securite-loi25.pdf (4 pages, 1.2 Mo).
